scientific_comparison.policy: All historical result payloads are runtime-free and compared exactly, including source hashes, data types and structure. Unknown schemas, duplicate keys, missing/extra fields and scientific differences fail. Mismatch reports retain at most 20 exact JSON-pointer paths plus total count.
